name: Gemini 335Lg
summary: Gemini 335Lg adds a GMSL2 serializer and locking FAKRA connector to the Gemini 335L stereo depth platform. It retains USB connectivity and provides depth, infrared, RGB and IMU data for autonomous mobile robots and robotic arms. Longer cable runs, hardware synchronization and an IP65 enclosure support industrial integration.

description.en: Gemini 335Lg adds a GMSL2 serializer and locking FAKRA connector to the Gemini 335L stereo depth platform. Longer cable runs, hardware synchronization and an IP65 enclosure support industrial integration.

sources.title: ROSCon 2024: Gemini 335Lg GMSL2 Camera for AMRs
sources.quote: Odense, Denmark, October 21, 2024 – Orbbec , a global leader in 3D vision systems, announced the launch of the Gemini 335Lg Stereo Vision 3D Camera at ROSCon 2024 . As the latest addition to the Gemini 330 series , the Gemini 335Lg utilizes advanced Gigabit Multimedia Serial Link 2 (GMSL2) and a FAKRA connector, ensuring secure and reliable connectivity for autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) in fulfillment centers, warehouses, and factories, as well as for robotic arms in complex tasks such as bin-picking and palletizing/de-palletizing.
